title: Control-policy recovery diagnostics print raw decode errors, which can repeat a stored value
outcome: A control-policy recovery finding names the record and the shape of the problem, never a value the record holds.
acceptance: Every detail the control-policy recovery report gives for a record that does not decode names the shape of the problem (an unknown or missing member by name, otherwise the category and position) and never repeats a value from the record; a test with a rule set holding an unknown check-kind value shows the value absent from the report and its text output.

completion.summary: Landed 4e1b0e1 (bundle 5A): control-policy recovery details name the shape of a record that does not decode (member name, or category and position), an invalid stored id or a kind mismatch, and never a stored value. Text lines are framed. The CLI test plants a hostile check-kind value, member, authority id and object kind and finds none of them in the JSON or the text.
